params.name: subject
params.description: Subject requesting access (maps to target.accessSubject)

params.name: resources
params.description: Resources being accessed (maps to target.resource.identifiers)

params.name: actions
params.description: Action being performed (maps to target.actions)

params.name: resource_type
params.description: Resource type (maps to target.resource.type) - e.g., "API", "API2"

params.name: attributes
params.description: Resource attributes being accessed (maps to target.resource.attributes)

params.name: issuer
params.description: Policy issuer (maps to policyIssuer)

params.name: service_provider
params.description: Service provider for environment constraints

params.name: license
params.description: License context for policy set matching

params.name: active_only
params.description: Optional parameter used to search by party's \"Active\" status.

params.name: name
params.description: Optional parameter used to search by party's name. Can contain a single * as wildcard.

params.name: eori
params.description:
Optional parameter used to search by party's EORI. Can contain a single * as wildcard. It searches through the
party_id array  for matching eori (contained in the party_id array). This parameter must be considered
deprecated and will be removed in future  releases.

params.name: party_id
params.description:
Optional parameter used to search by party's ID. Can contain a single * as wildcard. It searches through the
party_id array  for matching party_id.

params.name: certified_only
params.description: Search for parties that play one of the certified roles as defined in iSHARE role framework.

params.name: date_time
params.description: Search parties with a specific adherence date

params.name: adherenceStatus
params.description: Search for parties with adherence status like \"Active\", \"Revoked\",\"Not Active\", \"Pending\"

params.name: adherenceStartdate
params.description: Search parties with a specific adherence start date

params.name: adherenceEnddate
params.description: Search parties with a specific adherence end date

params.name: registrarPartyId
params.description: Search parties by their registrar Participant Registry's ID number

params.name: webSiteUrl
params.description: Search a party by their website URL

params.name: companyEmail
params.description: Search a party by their email ID

params.name: companyPhone
params.description: Search a party by their company phone number

params.name: publiclyPublishable
params.description: Search parties whose general company contact information is allowed to be published

params.name: tags
params.description:
Search parties who match any of the keywords that they have added in their participant information under tags.
It is a free text field and can contain any value

params.name: framework
params.description:
Search parties based on which framework they were onboarded with. Currently parties can only be registered with
\"iSHARE\" framework

params.name: subjectName
params.description:
Search parties based on the subject name of their PKI (x509) certificates. Usually to find a party who is
requesting tokens

params.name: role
params.description:
Search parties based on their roles as defined in the iSHARE role framework. Possible roles are ServiceConsumer,
ServiceProvider,  EntitledParty, AuthorisationRegistry, IdentityProvider,  IdentityBroker and IdentityBroker
and ParticipantRegistry,  iShareSatellite (deprecated, will be removed in future releases,  use
ParticipantRegistry instead).

params.name: loA
params.description:
Search parties based on their level of assurance which is registered in the participant list. Possible values
are Low/Substantial/High

params.name: compliancyVerified
params.description: Search parties that have their compliance to framework verified or not.

params.name: legalAdherence
params.description:
Search parties that have signed the appropriate legal agreements and that have been verified during or after
onboarding. Parties adhering to legal agreements are legally obliged to adhere to terms of use of data.

params.name: authorizationRegistryID
params.description:
Search parties based on their authorization registry provider. The ID of the authorization registry must be
provided in search parameter, and this must be listed as the authorization registry in the participant record

params.name: authorizationRegistryName
params.description:
Search parties based on their authorization registry provider. The name of the authorization registry must be
provided in search parameter and this must be listed as authorization registry in the participant record

params.name: dataSpaceID
params.description: Search parties based on data-spaces they participate in. The ID of the data-space must be provided

params.name: dataSpaceTitle
params.description: Search parties based on data-spaces they participate in. The name of the data-space must be provided

params.name: countriesOfOperation
params.description: Search parties by name of country they list as their country of operation

params.name: sectorIndustry
params.description: Search parties by name of sector they list as their sector/industry

params.name: page
params.description:
The parties API by default uses pagination. Each page size is fixed at 10 parties per page. When search results
into more then 10 parties, the page parameter must be added for next pages

params.name: size
params.description: into more then 10 parties, the page parameter must be added for next pages

params.name: certificate_subject_name
params.description:
Search parties based on the subject name of their PKI (x509) certificates. Usually to find a party who is
requesting tokens

params.name: party_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the party to retrieve

params.name: contract_id
params.description: Contract ID

params.name: contract_id
params.description: Contract ID

params.name: contract_id
params.description: Contract ID

params.name: contract_id
params.description: Contract ID
